description: This Java class 'WebSiteProperties' encapsulates configuration properties related to website URL settings such as HTTP/HTTPS ports and hosts, web application path, and HTTPS enablement. It provides methods to initialize configurations from properties files, entity values, or HTTP requests, and includes logic to adjust ports with offsets.

classes.name: WebSiteProperties
classes.description: A final class representing website configuration properties such as ports, hosts, web application path, and HTTPS settings, with various factory methods to initialize from properties, entities, or web requests.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Returns a WebSiteProperties instance initialized to settings from url.properties.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a WebSiteProperties instance based on values from an HttpServletRequest, entity, or url.properties, with logic to adjust ports and hosts if not explicitly set.

methods.name: addPortOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the ports by a configured offset, optionally adjusting HTTPS port based on addHttpsOffset.

methods.name: addPortOffset
methods.description: Helper method to add the offset to a given port string.

methods.name: updateHttpPort
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTP port.

methods.name: updateHttpHost
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTP host.

methods.name: updateHttpsPort
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTPS port.

methods.name: updateHttpsHost
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTPS host.

methods.name: updateWebappPath
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated web application path, trimming ending slash if present.

methods.name: updateEnableHttps
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTPS enable flag.

methods.name: getHttpPort
methods.description: Getter for HTTP port; returns an empty string if not configured.

methods.name: getHttpHost
methods.description: Getter for HTTP host; returns an empty string if not configured.

methods.name: getHttpsPort
methods.description: Getter for HTTPS port; returns an empty string if not configured.

methods.name: getHttpsHost
methods.description: Getter for HTTPS host; returns an empty string if not configured.

methods.name: getEnableHttps
methods.description: Returns true if HTTPS is enabled.

methods.name: getWebappPath
methods.description: Returns the configured webapp path or null.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the WebSiteProperties instance including all major fields.
